rule: Roster chain name -> CAIP-2 chain id, and the SLIP-44 asset reference of the chain's native asset (CAIP-19 slip44 namespace). One file read by functions/api/wrapper/_caip19.ts (the /api/wrapper/caip19 lookup and /api/wrapper/index.json) and scripts/readers/wrapper-caip-ledger.mjs (the candidate ledger), so the two can never key an asset differently. ERC-20 asset ids use the CAIP-19 erc20 namespace with the contract address lower-cased. A side with no chain (fund register, bank deposits, custody not on a ledger) has no CAIP-19 id and says why.

offchain.why_null: the asset is a register entry off any public ledger (fund shares at a transfer agent, bank deposits); CAIP-19 has no id for it
